options.text: Women retained their father's gotra throughout life in all royal dynasties

options.text: Endogamous marriage within the same gotra was compulsory across all varnas

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Social Histories of Early Societies (Kinship, Caste and Class) (Dharmashastras and Gotra Rules):
Women were expected to adopt their husband's gotra upon marriage, and members of the same gotra could not marry

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
